content: #1 In Oberwolfach Workshop, June 2009 -- Friday, June 12 there is a piece of the text that has not been ‘rendered’ and has stayed as ‘latex’ type text. I was unable to see what was wrong so thought to flag it up here.
subject: Text not rendered

content: #2 Hi Tim, I fixed the issues. Two things were happening, I think. One was that the indentation of a particular $$...$$ section meant it rendered verbatim, as code, and the other was that, in other places, there were minor TeX errors, and so the system gave the source, rather than trying to render it.
subject: Text not rendered
